article.title: Liverpool earn first league win at Anfield with victory over Brighton
article.summary: An own goal from Brighton's Pascal Gross swiftly followed by a goal from Alexander Isak, sees Liverpool beat the Seagulls 2-0 at Anfield to move into the Premier League top four.
